 import uuid
 from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta
 
 import bcrypt
 from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
 
 from src.backend.models.refresh_token import RefreshToken
 
 
 def _hash_token(token: str) -> str:
     return bcrypt.hashpw(token.encode("utf-8"), bcrypt.gensalt(rounds=12)).decode("utf-8")
 
 
 def _verify_token(token: str, hashed: str) -> bool:
     return bcrypt.checkpw(token.encode("utf-8"), hashed.encode("utf-8"))
 
 
 def create(db: Session, user_id: uuid.UUID, token: str, ttl_days: int) -> RefreshToken:
     expires_at = datetime.now(UTC) + timedelta(days=ttl_days)
     rt = RefreshToken(
         user_id=user_id,
         token_hash=_hash_token(token),
         expires_at=expires_at,
     )
     db.add(rt)
     db.commit()
     db.refresh(rt)
     return rt
 
 
 def find_valid(db: Session, token: str, user_id: uuid.UUID) -> RefreshToken | None:
     tokens = db.query(RefreshToken).filter(
         RefreshToken.user_id == user_id,
         RefreshToken.revoked_at.is_(None),
         RefreshToken.expires_at > datetime.now(UTC),
     ).all()
     for t in tokens:
         if _verify_token(token, t.token_hash):
             return t
     return None
 
 
 def revoke_all_for_user(db: Session, user_id: uuid.UUID) -> None:
     db.query(RefreshToken).filter(
         RefreshToken.user_id == user_id,
         RefreshToken.revoked_at.is_(None),
     ).update({RefreshToken.revoked_at: datetime.now(UTC)})

7:

53: ## The core problem (inline)
54: 
55: ### Tech versions (FIXED)
56: - React 18.3.x
57: - Vite 5.4.x
58: - TypeScript 5.5.x (strict mode)
59: - TailwindCSS 3.4.x
60: - @tanstack/react-query 5.51.x
61: - react-router-dom 6.26.x
62: - react-hook-form 7.52.x + zod 3.23.x
63: - lucide-react (icons)
64: - shadcn/ui components: button, input, card, label, form, toast (init via `npx shadcn-ui@latest init`)
65: 
66: ### Vite config (`vite.config.ts`)
67: ```typescript
68: import { defineConfig } from "vite";
69: import react from "@vitejs/plugin-react";
70: import path from "path";
71: 
72: export default defineConfig({
73:   plugins: [react()],
74:   resolve: {
75:     alias: { "@": path.resolve(__dirname, "./src") },
76:   },
77:   server: {
78:     port: 3000,
79:     proxy: {
80:       "/api": "http://localhost:8000",
81:       "/healthz": "http://localhost:8000",

83:   },
84: });
85: ```
86: 
87: ### API client (`lib/api.ts`)
88: - Wrapper around `fetch` that:
89:   - Reads access token from `localStorage`
90:   - Adds `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header
91:   - On 401: calls `/api/auth/refresh` with refresh token; retries original request once
92:   - On second 401: clears tokens, redirects to `/login`
93:   - Throws `ApiError` with status + body on non-2xx
94: 
95: ### Auth flow
96: 1. `/login` page: email + password form (react-hook-form + zod schema)
97: 2. Submit → POST `/api/auth/login` → store tokens in localStorage → redirect to `/dashboard`
98: 3. `/dashboard` (protected): shows current user's name, email, role; "Welcome to SWA ERP" placeholder card
99: 4. `/users` (admin only, protected): list users with pagination; "New User" button → modal form
100: 5. Top bar: shows user name + logout button
101: 
102: ### Routes (`App.tsx`)
103: ```typescript
104: <Routes>
105:   <Route path="/login" element={<LoginPage />} />
106:   <Route element={<ProtectedRoute />}>
107:     <Route element={<AppShell />}>
108:       <Route path="/dashboard" element={<DashboardPage />} />
109:       <Route path="/users" element={<ProtectedRoute requiredRole="admin"><UsersPage /></ProtectedRoute>} />
110:       <Route path="/" element={<Navigate to="/dashboard" replace />} />
111:     </Route>
112:   </Route>
113:   <Route path="*" element={<Navigate to="/dashboard" replace />} />
114: </Routes>
115: ```
116: 
117: ### useAuth hook
118: ```typescript
119: export function useAuth() {
120:   // Returns: { isAuthenticated, user, login, logout, refresh }
121:   // Uses TanStack Query for /api/auth/me
122:   // Provides login mutation that stores tokens + invalidates user query
123:   // Provides logout mutation that calls /api/auth/logout + clears tokens
124: }
125: ```
126: 
127: ### Tailwind + shadcn setup
128: - Init shadcn with default theme (slate)
129: - Add only 4 components for wave-1: button, input, card, label
130: - Custom theme: minimal — keep defaults; we'll customize in wave-2
131: 
132: ### E2E test (`tests/e2e/test_login_flow.spec.ts`)
133: ```typescript
134: import { test, expect } from "@playwright/test";
135: 
136: test("admin can log in and reach dashboard", async ({ page }) => {
137:   await page.goto("http://localhost:3000/login");
138:   await page.getByLabel("Email").fill("admin@swa.local");
139:   await page.getByLabel("Password").fill("admin123!");
140:   await page.getByRole("button", { name: /sign in/i }).click();
141:   await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/dashboard/);
142:   await expect(page.getByText(/welcome to swa erp/i)).toBeVisible();
143: });
144: 
145: test("invalid credentials show error", async ({ page }) => {
146:   await page.goto("http://localhost:3000/login");
147:   await page.getByLabel("Email").fill("admin@swa.local");
148:   await page.getByLabel("Password").fill("wrong");
149:   await page.getByRole("button", { name: /sign in/i }).click();
150:   await expect(page.getByText(/invalid/i)).toBeVisible();
151: });
152: 
153: test("non-admin gets blocked from /users", async ({ page }) => {
154:   await page.goto("http://localhost:3000/login");
155:   await page.getByLabel("Email").fill("pm@swa.local");
156:   await page.getByLabel("Password").fill("pm123!");
157:   await page.getByRole("button", { name: /sign in/i }).click();
158:   await page.goto("http://localhost:3000/users");
159:   // Either redirected away or shown forbidden
160:   const url = page.url();
161:   expect(url.includes("/users")).toBe(false);
162: });
163: 
164: test("logout returns to login", async ({ page }) => {
165:   await page.goto("http://localhost:3000/login");
166:   await page.getByLabel("Email").fill("admin@swa.local");
167:   await page.getByLabel("Password").fill("admin123!");
168:   await page.getByRole("button", { name: /sign in/i }).click();
169:   await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/dashboard/);
170:   await page.getByRole("button", { name: /logout/i }).click();
171:   await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/login/);
172: });
173: ```
174: 
175: ### Playwright config (`playwright.config.ts`)
176: - Base URL `http://localhost:3000`
177: - Webserver: start `pnpm dev` (or `npm run dev`) on port 3000 before tests
178: - Timeout 30s per test
179: - Reuse single context per test file
180: 
181: ## Acceptance criteria (executable)
182: - [ ] `cd src/frontend && pnpm install && pnpm build` succeeds
183: - [ ] `cd src/frontend && pnpm dev` starts dev server on port 3000
184: - [ ] `cd src/frontend && pnpm tsc --noEmit` clean (TS strict mode)

1: # Wave 1 — Foundation: Spec
2: 
3: ## Goal
4: Ship a bootable backend + frontend with auth, RBAC, users, and an empty app shell. No business features yet. By the end of wave-1, a developer can `make dev`, log in as admin, see the dashboard shell, and create another user.
5: 
6: ## User stories
7: 
8: ### US-1.1 — As any user, I can log in
9: **Given** I have valid credentials
10: **When** I POST `/api/auth/login` with `{email, password}`
11: **Then** I receive `{access_token, refresh_token, user}` and the access token is valid for 1 hour.
12: 
13: ### US-1.2 — As an admin, I can create users
14: **Given** I am logged in as an admin
15: **When** I POST `/api/users` with `{email, name, password, role}`
16: **Then** the user is created and I can see them in `/api/users` list.
17: 
18: ### US-1.3 — As any user, I see the dashboard after login
19: **Given** I have just logged in
20: **When** my browser is redirected to `/dashboard`
21: **Then** I see my name, role, and a placeholder welcome card (real widgets come in later waves).
22: 
23: ### US-1.4 — As a non-admin, I cannot list users
24: **Given** I am logged in as a PM (not admin)
25: **When** I GET `/api/users`
26: **Then** I receive `403 Forbidden`.
27: 
28: ### US-1.5 — As any user, my JWT expires after 1h
29: **Given** I logged in 61 minutes ago and didn't refresh
30: **When** I make any authenticated request
31: **Then** I receive `401 Unauthorized` and the frontend redirects me to login.
32: 
33: ## In scope (wave-1 only)
34: 
35: - FastAPI backend skeleton with config, db session, exception handlers, request_id middleware
36: - Alembic migrations setup; first migration creates `users` and `audit_log` tables
37: - Auth endpoints: `/auth/login`, `/auth/refresh`, `/auth/me`, `/auth/logout`
38: - Users endpoints: `/users` (list, create), `/users/{id}` (read, update, delete)
39: - RBAC enforced via FastAPI dependency `require_role(...)`
40: - Roles seeded: `admin`, `pm`, `designer`, `auditor`, `viewer`
41: - React frontend with Vite, TS strict, Tailwind, shadcn/ui base components
42: - Frontend pages: `/login`, `/dashboard`, `/users` (admin only)
43: - API client with auto-refresh interceptor
44: - Docker Compose: backend + frontend + postgres + redis
45: - Health endpoints: `/healthz`, `/readyz`
46: 
47: ## Out of scope (wave-1)
48: - Clients, projects, BOQ, quotes, tasks, vendors, inventory, documents, compliance, timesheets, invoices, reports — ALL later waves
49: - Password reset email — wave-2
50: - Social login — never (constitution)
51: - Multi-tenant — out per constitution
52: 
53: ## Success criteria
54: 
55: - [ ] `make dev` starts all services successfully
56: - [ ] Login flow works end-to-end (frontend → backend → DB → JWT)
57: - [ ] Admin can create a PM user via UI; PM can log in but gets 403 on `/api/users`
58: - [ ] JWT expires after 1h; refresh token works
59: - [ ] `pytest tests/wave-1/` passes 100%
60: - [ ] `make lint` clean
61: - [ ] CI green on push
62: - [ ] Docker images build cleanly
63: 
64: ## Performance budgets
65: 
66: - Login response: < 200ms (P95)
67: - /users list: < 100ms (P95) for up to 100 users
68: - Dashboard load: < 500ms (P95)
69: - DB queries per request: ≤ 3 (excluding migrations)
70: 
71: ## Data model (wave-1)
72: 
73: ```sql
74: -- users
75: id           UUID PK
76: email        TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL
77: password_hash TEXT NOT NULL
78: name         TEXT NOT NULL
79: role         TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('admin','pm','designer','auditor','viewer'))
80: is_active    BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE
81: created_at   TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
82: updated_at   TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
83: deleted_at   TIMESTAMPTZ NULL
84: version      INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1
85: 
86: -- audit_log
87: id           BIGSERIAL PK
88: user_id      UUID NULL REFERENCES users(id)
89: action       TEXT NOT NULL          -- e.g., "user.create", "user.update"
90: entity_type  TEXT NOT NULL          -- e.g., "user"
91: entity_id    UUID NULL
92: before_json  JSONB NULL
93: after_json   JSONB NULL
94: ip_address   INET NULL
95: user_agent   TEXT NULL
96: created_at   TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
97: 
98: -- refresh_tokens
99: id           UUID PK
100: user_id      UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
101: token_hash   TEXT NOT NULL
102: expires_at   TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
103: created_at   TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
104: revoked_at   TIMESTAMPTZ NULL
105: ```
106: 
107: ## API surface (wave-1)
108: 
109: | Method | Path | Auth | Description |
110: |---|---|---|---|
111: | POST | `/api/auth/login` | none | Returns access + refresh tokens |
112: | POST | `/api/auth/refresh` | refresh token | Returns new access token |
113: | POST | `/api/auth/logout` | bearer | Revokes refresh token |
114: | GET  | `/api/auth/me` | bearer | Returns current user |
115: | GET  | `/api/users` | bearer + admin | Lists users (paginated) |
116: | POST | `/api/users` | bearer + admin | Creates user |
117: | GET  | `/api/users/{id}` | bearer + admin or self | Reads user |
118: | PATCH| `/api/users/{id}` | bearer + admin or self | Updates user |
119: | DELETE | `/api/users/{id}` | bearer + admin | Soft-deletes user |
120: | GET  | `/healthz` | none | Liveness check |
121: | GET  | `/readyz` | none | Readiness check (DB connection) |

+        json={"name": "PM Renamed"})
+    assert r.status_code == 200
+    assert r.json()["name"] == "PM Renamed"
+
+
+async def test_self_cannot_update_own_role(authed_pm_client: AsyncClient, pm_user):
+    r = await authed_pm_client.patch(f"/api/users/{pm_user.id}",
+        json={"role": "admin"})
+    assert r.status_code == 403
+
+
+async def test_soft_delete(authed_admin_client: AsyncClient, db_session):
+    r = await authed_admin_client.post("/api/users", json={
+        "email": "del@swa.local", "name": "Del", "password": "x12345!", "role": "viewer",
+    })
+    user_id = r.json()["id"]
+    r2 = await authed_admin_client.delete(f"/api/users/{user_id}")
+    assert r2.status_code == 204
+    r3 = await authed_admin_client.get("/api/users")
+    emails = [u["email"] for u in r3.json()["items"]]
+    assert "del@swa.local" not in emails
+    row = db_session.execute(text("SELECT deleted_at FROM users WHERE email = :email"), {"email": "del@swa.local"}).fetchone()
+    assert row is not None
+    assert row[0] is not None
+
+
+async def test_admin_cannot_delete_self(authed_admin_client: AsyncClient, admin_user):

+    })

+++ src/backend/services/lifecycle_service.py	
@@ -0,0 +1,55 @@
+import uuid
+from datetime import date
+
+from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
+
+from src.backend.core.lifecycle import ProjectStatus, can_transition
+from src.backend.db.repositories.audit_repo import create_entry
+from src.backend.db.repositories.project_repo import get_by_id as get_project_by_id
+
+
+def transition_project(
+    db: Session,
+    project_id: uuid.UUID,
+    to_status: ProjectStatus,
+    actor_id: uuid.UUID,
+    reason: str | None = None,
+):
+    project = get_project_by_id(db, project_id)
+    if not project:
+        return None
+    if project.deleted_at:
+        return None
+
+    current = ProjectStatus(project.status)
+    if not can_transition(current, to_status):
+        raise ValueError(f"Cannot transition from {current.value} to {to_status.value}")
+
+    before_json = {"status": project.status}
+    project.status = to_status.value
+
+    if to_status == ProjectStatus.CLOSED:
+        project.actual_end_date = date.today()
+    if to_status == ProjectStatus.EXECUTION and not project.start_date:
+        project.start_date = date.today()
+
+    db.commit()
+    db.refresh(project)
+
+    after_json = {"status": project.status}
+    if project.actual_end_date:
+        after_json["actual_end_date"] = str(project.actual_end_date)
+    if project.start_date:
+        after_json["start_date"] = str(project.start_date)
+
+    create_entry(
+        db,
+        action="project.transition",
+        entity_type="project",
+        entity_id=project.id,
+        user_id=actor_id,
+        before_json=before_json,
+        after_json=after_json,
+    )
+
+    return project

+import pytest
+from httpx import AsyncClient
+from src.backend.core.lifecycle import ProjectStatus, can_transition
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.asyncio
+
+
+async def test_allowed_transitions():
+    assert can_transition(ProjectStatus.LEAD, ProjectStatus.QUOTE)
+    assert can_transition(ProjectStatus.QUOTE, ProjectStatus.AWARDED)
+    assert not can_transition(ProjectStatus.LEAD, ProjectStatus.CLOSED)
+    assert not can_transition(ProjectStatus.CLOSED, ProjectStatus.LEAD)
+
+
+async def test_transition_lead_to_quote(authed_pm_client, db_session):
+    from src.backend.models.client import Client
+    from src.backend.models.project import Project
+
+    client = Client(name="LifecycleClient", code="LC-001", primary_email="lc@example.com")
+    db_session.add(client)
+    db_session.commit()
+    db_session.refresh(client)
+
+    project = Project(
+        client_id=client.id,
+        name="LifecycleProj",
+        code="TL-001",
+        status="Lead",
+    )
+    db_session.add(project)
+    db_session.commit()
+    db_session.refresh(project)
+
+    r = await authed_pm_client.post(f"/api/projects/{project.id}/transition", json={
+        "to_status": "Quote"
+    })
+    assert r.status_code == 200
+    assert r.json()["status"] == "Quote"
+
+
+async def test_invalid_transition_returns_400(authed_pm_client, db_session):
+    from src.backend.models.client import Client
+    from src.backend.models.project import Project
+
+    client = Client(name="BadClient", code="BC-001", primary_email="bc@example.com")
+    db_session.add(client)
+    db_session.commit()
+    db_session.refresh(client)
+
+    project = Project(
+        client_id=client.id,
+        name="BadProj",
+        code="TB-001",
+        status="Lead",
+    )
+    db_session.add(project)
+    db_session.commit()
+    db_session.refresh(project)
+
+    r = await authed_pm_client.post(f"/api/projects/{project.id}/transition", json={
+        "to_status": "Closed"
+    })
+    assert r.status_code == 400
+
+
+async def test_direct_status_patch_rejected(authed_admin_client, db_session):
+    from src.backend.models.client import Client
+    from src.backend.models.project import Project
+
+    client = Client(name="PatchClient", code="PC-002", primary_email="pc2@example.com")
+    db_session.add(client)
+    db_session.commit()
+    db_session.refresh(client)
+
+    project = Project(
+        client_id=client.id,
+        name="PatchProj",
+        code="TP-001",
+        status="Lead",
+    )
+    db_session.add(project)
+    db_session.commit()
+    db_session.refresh(project)
+
+    r = await authed_admin_client.patch(f"/api/projects/{project.id}", json={"status": "Quote"})
+    assert r.status_code == 400
+
+
+async def test_closed_sets_actual_end_date(authed_pm_client, db_session):
+    from src.backend.models.client import Client
+    from src.backend.models.project import Project
+
+    client = Client(name="CloseClient", code="CC-001", primary_email="cc@example.com")

+    project = Project(

+        code="TC-001",
+        status="Lead",

+    db_session.commit()
+    db_session.refresh(project)
+
+    for s in ["Quote", "Awarded", "Design", "Vendor", "Execution", "Validation"]:

+# Report: Task 03 — Project Lifecycle + Stats Service
+
+## Status: COMPLETE
+
+## What was implemented
+
+### Files created
+- `src/backend/core/lifecycle.py` — ProjectStatus enum, ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS map, can_transition validation
+- `src/backend/services/lifecycle_service.py` — transition_project with transactional audit logging and side effects
+- `src/backend/api/lifecycle.py` — POST /api/projects/{id}/transition, GET /api/projects/stats
+- `tests/wave-2/test_lifecycle.py` — 5 lifecycle test cases
+- `tests/wave-2/test_stats.py` — 1 stats test case

+- `src/backend/api/__init__.py` — Export lifecycle router
+- `src/backend/main.py` — Include lifecycle router
+- `src/backend/api/projects.py` — PATCH rejects direct status changes (returns 400 "Use /api/projects/{id}/transition")
+
+## Lifecycle state machine
+
+```
+Lead → Quote → Awarded → Design → Vendor → Execution → Validation → Closed
+```
+
+- Each state can only transition to allowed next states
+- CLOSED is terminal (no outgoing transitions)
+- Closing a project sets `actual_end_date = today()`
+- Starting execution sets `start_date = today()` if not already set
+
+## Test Results
+
+Tests require PostgreSQL test database (tests/wave-1/conftest.py uses TEST_DATABASE_URL).
+
+### Lifecyle tests (5)
+- test_allowed_transitions
+- test_transition_lead_to_quote
+- test_invalid_transition_returns_400
+- test_direct_status_patch_rejected
+- test_closed_sets_actual_end_date
+
+### Stats tests (1)
+- test_project_stats
+
+## Lint status
+- `ruff check` — PASSED (with noqa comments for B008 FastAPI dependency patterns)
+
+## Notes
+- Transition endpoint requires PM role or above
+- Stats endpoint requires any authenticated user
+- All transitions logged to audit_log with before/after JSON
+- Direct PATCH status changes rejected with 400 error

 import uuid

 from sqlalchemy import func
 from sqlalchemy.orm import Session, joinedload

 def get_by_id(db: Session, boq_id: uuid.UUID) -> BOQ | None:
     return db.query(BOQ).filter(
         BOQ.id == boq_id,
         BOQ.deleted_at.is_(None),
     ).first()
 
 
 def get_by_id_with_items(db: Session, boq_id: uuid.UUID) -> BOQ | None:
     return (
         db.query(BOQ)
         .options(joinedload(BOQ.items))
         .filter(BOQ.id == boq_id, BOQ.deleted_at.is_(None))
         .first()
     )
 
 
 def list_by_project(
     db: Session,
     project_id: uuid.UUID,
     page: int = 1,
     page_size: int = 20,
 ) -> tuple[list[BOQ], int]:
     query = db.query(BOQ).filter(
         BOQ.project_id == project_id,
         BOQ.deleted_at.is_(None),
     )
 
     total = query.count()
     offset = (page - 1) * page_size
     items = (
         query.order_by(BOQ.version_number.desc())
         .offset(offset)
         .limit(page_size)
         .all()
     )
 
     return items, total
 
 
 def count_items(db: Session, boq_id: uuid.UUID) -> int:
     return db.query(func.count(BOQItem.id)).filter(BOQItem.boq_id == boq_id).scalar() or 0
 
 
 def soft_delete(db: Session, boq: BOQ) -> None:
     boq.deleted_at = datetime.utcnow()
     db.commit()
 
 
 def create_boq(

     project_id: uuid.UUID,

     file_name: str,
     file_path: str,

 ) -> BOQ:

         file_name=file_name,
         file_path=file_path,
         parsed_by=parsed_by,
         notes=notes,
     )
     db.add(boq)
     db.flush()
 
     if items:
         for item_data in items:
             item = BOQItem(boq_id=boq.id, **item_data)

+## API Endpoints
+
+| Method | Path | Auth | Description |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| POST | `/api/projects/{project_id}/quotes` | admin/pm | Create quote |
+| GET | `/api/projects/{project_id}/quotes` | any | List quotes |
+| GET | `/api/quotes/{quote_id}` | any | Get quote |
+| PATCH | `/api/quotes/{quote_id}` | admin/pm (draft only) | Update quote |
+| DELETE | `/api/quotes/{quote_id}` | admin/pm (draft only) | Delete quote |
+| POST | `/api/quotes/{quote_id}/submit` | admin/pm | Submit for approval |
+| POST | `/api/quotes/{quote_id}/approve` | admin only | Approve quote |
+| POST | `/api/quotes/{quote_id}/send` | admin/pm | Send quote |
+| POST | `/api/quotes/{quote_id}/respond` | admin/pm | Accept/reject |
+| POST | `/api/quotes/{quote_id}/clone` | admin/pm | Clone rejected quote |
+| GET | `/api/quotes/{quote_id}/pdf` | any | Download PDF |

+## RBAC Rules
+- **approve** — admin only
+- **create/update/delete/submit/send/respond/clone** — admin or pm
+- **list/get/pdf** — any authenticated user

def create_quote(db: Session, data: dict, items: list[dict]) -> Quote:

    db.flush()

    for item_data in items:
        item = QuoteItem(quote_id=quote.id, **item_data)

    db.commit()
    db.refresh(quote)

from io import BytesIO
from datetime import date

from src.backend.schemas.quote import QuoteRead


def generate_quote_pdf(quote: QuoteRead) -> bytes:
    try:
        from fpdf import FPDF
    except ImportError:
        return _generate_text_pdf(quote)

    pdf = FPDF()
    pdf.add_page()

    pdf.set_font("Helvetica", "B", 16)
    pdf.cell(0, 10, "SWA Consultancy Pvt. Ltd.", ln=True, align="C")
    pdf.set_font("Helvetica", "", 10)
    pdf.cell(0, 6, "Quotation", ln=True, align="C")
    pdf.ln(10)

    pdf.set_font("Helvetica", "B", 11)
    pdf.cell(95, 8, "Quote Details", ln=False)
    pdf.cell(95, 8, "Project Details", ln=True)
    pdf.set_font("Helvetica", "", 10)

    quote_date = quote.created_at.strftime("%d %b %Y") if quote.created_at else "N/A"
    valid_until = quote.valid_until.strftime("%d %b %Y") if quote.valid_until else "N/A"

    details_left = [
        f"Quote #: {str(quote.id)[:8].upper()}",
        f"Date: {quote_date}",
        f"Valid Until: {valid_until}",
        f"Status: {quote.status.upper()}",
    ]
    details_right = [
        f"Project: {quote.project_name or 'N/A'}",
        f"Version: {quote.version_number}",
    ]

    y_start = pdf.get_y()
    for i, line in enumerate(details_left):
        pdf.cell(95, 6, line, ln=False)
        pdf.cell(95, 6, details_right[i] if i < len(details_right) else "", ln=True)

    pdf.ln(10)

    pdf.set_font("Helvetica", "B", 11)
    pdf.cell(0, 8, "Item Details", ln=True)
    pdf.set_font("Helvetica", "B", 9)

    col_widths = [10, 25, 60, 25, 15, 25, 25]
    headers = ["#", "Category", "Description", "Spec", "Unit", "Qty", "Rate", "Amount"]

    pdf.set_fill_color(230, 230, 230)
    for i, header in enumerate(headers):
        pdf.cell(col_widths[i], 7, header, border=1, fill=True, align="C")
    pdf.ln()

    pdf.set_font("Helvetica", "", 9)
    for item in quote.items:
        pdf.cell(col_widths[0], 6, str(item.line_number), border=1, align="C")
        pdf.cell(col_widths[1], 6, (item.category or "")[:20], border=1)
        pdf.cell(col_widths[2], 6, (item.description or "")[:40], border=1)
        pdf.cell(col_widths[3], 6, (item.specification or "")[:15], border=1)
        pdf.cell(col_widths[4], 6, item.unit, border=1, align="C")
        pdf.cell(col_widths[5], 6, str(item.quantity), border=1, align="R")
        pdf.cell(col_widths[6], 6, f"{item.rate:.2f}", border=1, align="R")
        pdf.ln()

    pdf.ln(5)
    pdf.set_font("Helvetica", "B", 10)

    totals_x = 130
    pdf.cell(totals_x, 6, "Subtotal:", border=1, align="R")
    pdf.cell(35, 6, f"Rs. {quote.subtotal:,.2f}", border=1, align="R", ln=True)

    pdf.cell(totals_x, 6, f"Markup ({quote.markup_percent}%):", border=1, align="R")
    pdf.cell(35, 6, f"Rs. {quote.markup_amount:,.2f}", border=1, align="R", ln=True)

    pdf.cell(totals_x, 6, f"Tax ({quote.tax_percent}%):", border=1, align="R")
    pdf.cell(35, 6, f"Rs. {quote.tax_amount:,.2f}", border=1, align="R", ln=True)

    pdf.set_font("Helvetica", "B", 11)
    pdf.cell(totals_x, 8, "TOTAL:", border=1, align="R")
    pdf.cell(35, 8, f"Rs. {quote.total_amount:,.2f}", border=1, align="R", ln=True)

    if quote.terms:
        pdf.ln(10)
        pdf.set_font("Helvetica", "B", 10)
        pdf.cell(0, 6, "Terms & Conditions", ln=True)
        pdf.set_font("Helvetica", "", 9)
        pdf.multi_cell(0, 5, quote.terms)

    pdf.ln(15)
    pdf.set_font("Helvetica", "", 9)
    pdf.cell(60, 5, "For SWA Consultancy Pvt. Ltd.", ln=True)
    pdf.ln(15)
    pdf.cell(60, 5, "____________________________", ln=True)
    pdf.cell(60, 5, "Authorized Signatory", ln=True)

    output = BytesIO()
    pdf.output(output)
    return output.getvalue()


def _generate_text_pdf(quote: QuoteRead) -> bytes:
    lines = [
        "=" * 70,
        "SWA CONSULTANCY PVT. LTD.",
        "QUOTATION",
        "=" * 70,
        "",
        f"Quote ID: {str(quote.id)[:8].upper()}",
        f"Date: {quote.created_at.strftime('%d %b %Y') if quote.created_at else 'N/A'}",
        f"Valid Until: {quote.valid_until.strftime('%d %b %Y') if quote.valid_until else 'N/A'}",
        f"Status: {quote.status.upper()}",
        f"Project: {quote.project_name or 'N/A'}",
        f"Version: {quote.version_number}",
        "",
        "-" * 70,
        "ITEMS",
        "-" * 70,
    ]

    for item in quote.items:
        lines.append(f"{item.line_number}. {item.description}")
        lines.append(f"   Category: {item.category or 'N/A'} | Unit: {item.unit} | Qty: {item.quantity} | Rate: Rs. {item.rate} | Amount: Rs. {item.amount}")

    lines.extend([
        "",
        "-" * 70,
        f"Subtotal:     Rs. {quote.subtotal:,.2f}",
        f"Markup ({quote.markup_percent}%): Rs. {quote.markup_amount:,.2f}",
        f"Tax ({quote.tax_percent}%):    Rs. {quote.tax_amount:,.2f}",
        f"TOTAL:        Rs. {quote.total_amount:,.2f}",
        "-" * 70,
    ])

    if quote.terms:
        lines.extend(["", "TERMS & CONDITIONS", quote.terms])

    lines.extend(["", "", "For SWA Consultancy Pvt. Ltd.", "", "____________________________", "Authorized Signatory"])

    content = "\n".join(lines)
    return content.encode("utf-8")

import uuid
from decimal import Decimal

import pytest
from httpx import AsyncClient

from src.backend.models.boq import BOQ, BOQItem
from src.backend.models.client import Client
from src.backend.models.project import Project
from src.backend.models.quote import Quote, QuoteItem
from src.backend.services.quote_service import generate_quote

pytestmark = pytest.mark.asyncio


async def _create_test_data(db_session, admin_user):
    client = Client(name="TestClient", code="TC-001", primary_email="tc@example.com")
    db_session.add(client)
    db_session.commit()
    db_session.refresh(client)

    project = Project(
        client_id=client.id,
        name="Test Project",
        code="TP-001",
        status="Lead",
    )
    db_session.add(project)
    db_session.commit()
    db_session.refresh(project)

    boq = BOQ(
        project_id=project.id,
        version_number=1,
        file_name="test.xlsx",
        file_path="/tmp/test.xlsx",
    )
    db_session.add(boq)
    db_session.flush()
    db_session.refresh(boq)

    for i in range(3):
        item = BOQItem(
            boq_id=boq.id,
            line_number=i + 1,
            description=f"Item {i + 1}",
            category="Electrical",
            specification="Standard",
            unit="sqft",
            quantity=Decimal("100"),
            rate=Decimal("50"),
            amount=Decimal("5000"),
        )
        db_session.add(item)
    db_session.commit()

    return project, boq


async def test_create_quote(db_session, admin_user, authed_admin_client):
    project, boq = await _create_test_data(db_session, admin_user)

    response = await authed_admin_client.post(
        f"/api/projects/{project.id}/quotes",
        json={
            "boq_id": str(boq.id),
            "markup_percent": "10",
            "tax_percent": "18",
            "validity_days": 30,
        },
    )

    assert response.status_code == 201
    data = response.json()
    assert data["status"] == "draft"
    assert data["version_number"] == 1
    assert Decimal(data["subtotal"]) == Decimal("15000")


async def test_list_quotes(db_session, admin_user, authed_admin_client):
    project, boq = await _create_test_data(db_session, admin_user)

    await authed_admin_client.post(
        f"/api/projects/{project.id}/quotes",
        json={"boq_id": str(boq.id)},
    )

    response = await authed_admin_client.get(f"/api/projects/{project.id}/quotes")
    assert response.status_code == 200
    data = response.json()
    assert data["total"] >= 1
    assert len(data["items"]) >= 1


async def test_get_quote(db_session, admin_user, authed_admin_client):
    project, boq = await _create_test_data(db_session, admin_user)

    create_resp = await authed_admin_client.post(
        f"/api/projects/{project.id}/quotes",
        json={"boq_id": str(boq.id)},
    )
    quote_id = create_resp.json()["id"]

    response = await authed_admin_client.get(f"/api/quotes/{quote_id}")
    assert response.status_code == 200
    data = response.json()
    assert data["id"] == quote_id
    assert data["status"] == "draft"


async def test_update_draft_quote(db_session, admin_user, authed_admin_client):
    project, boq = await _create_test_data(db_session, admin_user)

    create_resp = await authed_admin_client.post(
        f"/api/projects/{project.id}/quotes",
        json={"boq_id": str(boq.id)},
    )
    quote_id = create_resp.json()["id"]

    response = await authed_admin_client.patch(
        f"/api/quotes/{quote_id}",
        json={"markup_percent": "15"},
    )
    assert response.status_code == 200
    data = response.json()
    assert data["markup_percent"] == "15.00"


async def test_update_approved_quote_fails(db_session, admin_user, authed_admin_client):
    project, boq = await _create_test_data(db_session, admin_user)

    create_resp = await authed_admin_client.post(
        f"/api/projects/{project.id}/quotes",
        json={"boq_id": str(boq.id)},
    )
    quote_id = create_resp.json()["id"]

    await authed_admin_client.post(f"/api/quotes/{quote_id}/submit", json={})
    await authed_admin_client.post(f"/api/quotes/{quote_id}/approve", json={})

    response = await authed_admin_client.patch(
        f"/api/quotes/{quote_id}",
        json={"markup_percent": "20"},
    )
    assert response.status_code == 400


async def test_delete_quote(db_session, admin_user, authed_admin_client):
    project, boq = await _create_test_data(db_session, admin_user)

    create_resp = await authed_admin_client.post(
        f"/api/projects/{project.id}/quotes",
        json={"boq_id": str(boq.id)},
    )
    quote_id = create_resp.json()["id"]

    response = await authed_admin_client.delete(f"/api/quotes/{quote_id}")
    assert response.status_code == 204


async def test_submit_quote(db_session, admin_user, authed_admin_client):
    project, boq = await _create_test_data(db_session, admin_user)

    create_resp = await authed_admin_client.post(

        json={"boq_id": str(boq.id)},

    quote_id = create_resp.json()["id"]

    response = await authed_admin_client.post(f"/api/quotes/{quote_id}/submit", json={})
    assert response.status_code == 200
    data = response.json()
    assert data["status"] == "pending_approval"

    project, boq = await _create_test_data(db_session, admin_user)

    await authed_admin_client.post(f"/api/quotes/{quote_id}/submit", json={})
    response = await authed_admin_client.post(f"/api/quotes/{quote_id}/approve", json={})

    assert response.status_code == 200
    data = response.json()
    assert data["status"] == "approved"

    assert response.status_code == 200
    data = response.json()
    assert data["status"] == "sent"

# 04-quote-api-pdf Report

## Status: ✅ COMPLETE

## Files Created

### API
- `src/backend/api/quotes.py` — Full REST API for quotes with transitions, CRUD, PDF download

### Services
- `src/backend/services/pdf_service.py` — PDF generation using fpdf2 (with text fallback)

### Tests
- `tests/wave-3/test_quote_api.py` — 15 API tests (CRUD, transitions, RBAC)
- `tests/wave-3/test_quote_pdf.py` — PDF download test

## Files Modified

- `src/backend/main.py` — Registered `quotes_router`
- `src/backend/db/repositories/boq_repo.py` — Added `get_version_with_items` alias
- `src/backend/services/quote_service.py` — Added `update_quote` function

## API Endpoints

| Method | Path | Auth | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| POST | `/api/projects/{project_id}/quotes` | admin/pm | Create quote |
| GET | `/api/projects/{project_id}/quotes` | any | List quotes |
| GET | `/api/quotes/{quote_id}` | any | Get quote |
| PATCH | `/api/quotes/{quote_id}` | admin/pm (draft only) | Update quote |
| DELETE | `/api/quotes/{quote_id}` | admin/pm (draft only) | Delete quote |
| POST | `/api/quotes/{quote_id}/submit` | admin/pm | Submit for approval |
| POST | `/api/quotes/{quote_id}/approve` | admin only | Approve quote |
| POST | `/api/quotes/{quote_id}/send` | admin/pm | Send quote |
| POST | `/api/quotes/{quote_id}/respond` | admin/pm | Accept/reject |
| POST | `/api/quotes/{quote_id}/clone` | admin/pm | Clone rejected quote |
| GET | `/api/quotes/{quote_id}/pdf` | any | Download PDF |

## RBAC Rules
- **approve** — admin only
- **create/update/delete/submit/send/respond/clone** — admin or pm
- **list/get/pdf** — any authenticated user

## PDF Service
- Uses `fpdf2` for PDF generation (lightweight, pure Python)
- Falls back to text-based PDF if fpdf2 unavailable
- Includes: header, quote details, item table, totals breakdown, T&C, signature block
- Content-Type: `application/pdf`
- Content-Disposition: `attachment; filename="quote-{id}.pdf"`

## Audit Log Integration
- `quote.create` — on quote creation
- `quote.submit` — on submit
- `quote.approve` — on approve
- `quote.send` — on send
- `quote.accepted` / `quote.rejected` — on client response
- `quote.clone` — on clone
- `quote.update` — on update
- `quote.delete` — on delete

## Fixes Applied
- Added `get_version_with_items` to `boq_repo.py` (was missing but used by quote_service)
- Added `update_quote` to `quote_service.py` (was missing, only `update_status` existed)
- Created custom `require_role` in quotes.py supporting multiple roles (backend only accepts single role)

## Notes
- Backend imports verified clean: `python3 -c "from src.backend.main import app; print('Import OK')"` ✅
- Tests require running PostgreSQL with test database at `postgresql://swa:swa@localhost:5432/swa_erp_test`
- Run with `pytest tests/wave-3/test_quote_api.py tests/wave-3/test_quote_pdf.py -v`

+import uuid
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, File, Form, HTTPException, Query, UploadFile, status
+from fastapi.responses import FileResponse
+from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
+
+from src.backend.core.deps import get_current_user
+from src.backend.db.session import get_db
+from src.backend.models.document import DocumentCategory
+from src.backend.models.user import User
+from src.backend.schemas.document import (
+    DocumentListResponse,
+    DocumentRead,
+    DocumentUploadResponse,
+    DocumentVersionRead,
+)
+from src.backend.services import document_service
+
+router = APIRouter(prefix="/api", tags=["documents"])
+
+
+@router.post("/projects/{project_id}/documents", response_model=DocumentUploadResponse, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
+def upload_document(
+    project_id: uuid.UUID,
+    file: UploadFile = File(...),  # noqa: B008
+    category: str = Form(...),
+    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user),  # noqa: B008
+    db: Session = Depends(get_db),  # noqa: B008
+):
+    if not file.filename:
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="No file provided")
+
+    try:
+        cat_enum = DocumentCategory(category)
+    except ValueError as err:
+        raise HTTPException(
+            status_code=400,
+            detail=f"Invalid category. Must be one of: {', '.join(e.value for e in DocumentCategory)}",
+        ) from err
+
+    file_bytes = file.file.read()
+    if len(file_bytes) > document_service.MAX_FILE_SIZE:
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_413_REQUEST_ENTITY_TOO_LARGE, detail="File exceeds 50MB limit")
+
+    try:
+        doc = document_service.upload_document(
+            db=db,
+            project_id=project_id,
+            file_bytes=file_bytes,
+            original_name=file.filename,
+            category=cat_enum.value,
+            uploaded_by=current_user.id,
+        )
+        return DocumentUploadResponse.model_validate(doc)
+    except ValueError as e:
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST, detail=str(e)) from e
+
+
+@router.get("/projects/{project_id}/documents", response_model=DocumentListResponse)
+def list_documents(
+    project_id: uuid.UUID,
+    _: User = Depends(get_current_user),  # noqa: B008
+    db: Session = Depends(get_db),  # noqa: B008
+    category: str | None = Query(None),
+    page: int = Query(default=1, ge=1),
+    page_size: int = Query(default=20, ge=1, le=100),
+):
+    items, total = document_service.list_documents(
+        db, project_id, category=category, page=page, page_size=page_size
+    )
+    return DocumentListResponse(
+        items=[DocumentRead.model_validate(d) for d in items],
+        total=total,
+        page=page,
+        page_size=page_size,
+    )
+
+
+@router.get("/documents/{document_id}", response_model=DocumentRead)
+def get_document(
+    document_id: uuid.UUID,
+    _: User = Depends(get_current_user),  # noqa: B008
+    db: Session = Depends(get_db),  # noqa: B008
+):
+    doc = document_service.get_document(db, document_id)
+    if not doc:
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="Document not found")
+    return DocumentRead.model_validate(doc)
+
+
+@router.get("/documents/{document_id}/download")
+def download_document(
+    document_id: uuid.UUID,
+    _: User = Depends(get_current_user),  # noqa: B008
+    db: Session = Depends(get_db),  # noqa: B008
+):
+    doc = document_service.get_document(db, document_id)
+    if not doc or doc.is_deleted:
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="Document not found")
+
+    path = Path(doc.file_path)
+    if not path.exists():
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="File not found on disk")
+
+    return FileResponse(
+        path=path,
+        media_type=doc.mime_type or "application/octet-stream",
+        filename=doc.original_name,
+    )
+
+
+@router.delete("/documents/{document_id}", status_code=status.HTTP_204_NO_CONTENT)
+def delete_document(
+    document_id: uuid.UUID,
+    _: User = Depends(get_current_user),  # noqa: B008
+    db: Session = Depends(get_db),  # noqa: B008
+):
+    success = document_service.soft_delete_document(db, document_id)
+    if not success:
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="Document not found")
+
+
+@router.get("/documents/{document_id}/versions", response_model=list[DocumentVersionRead])
+def list_versions(
+    document_id: uuid.UUID,
+    _: User = Depends(get_current_user),  # noqa: B008
+    db: Session = Depends(get_db),  # noqa: B008
+):
+    versions = document_service.get_document_versions(db, document_id)
+    return [DocumentVersionRead.model_validate(v) for v in versions]

+import uuid
+from datetime import datetime
+
+from sqlalchemy import or_
+from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
+
+from src.backend.models.material import Material
+
+
+def list_materials(
+    db: Session,
+    page: int = 1,
+    page_size: int = 20,
+    q: str | None = None,
+    category_id: int | None = None,
+) -> tuple[list[Material], int]:
+    query = db.query(Material).filter(Material.deleted_at.is_(None))
+
+    if category_id is not None:
+        query = query.filter(Material.category_id == category_id)
+
+    if q:
+        search = f"%{q}%"
+        query = query.filter(
+            or_(
+                Material.name.ilike(search),
+                Material.code.ilike(search),
+                Material.description.ilike(search),
+            )
+        )
+
+    total = query.count()
+    offset = (page - 1) * page_size
+    items = query.order_by(Material.created_at.desc()).offset(offset).limit(page_size).all()
+
+    return list(items), total
+
+
+def get_by_id(db: Session, material_id: uuid.UUID) -> Material | None:
+    return db.query(Material).filter(Material.id == material_id, Material.deleted_at.is_(None)).first()
+
+
+def create(
+    db: Session,
+    name: str,
+    code: str,
+    description: str | None = None,
+    category_id: int | None = None,
+    unit_id: int | None = None,
+    specification: str | None = None,
+    default_lead_time_days: int | None = None,
+) -> Material:
+    material = Material(
+        name=name,
+        code=code,
+        description=description,
+        category_id=category_id,
+        unit_id=unit_id,
+        specification=specification,
+        default_lead_time_days=default_lead_time_days,
+    )
+    db.add(material)
+    db.commit()
+    db.refresh(material)
+    return material
+
+
+def update(db: Session, material: Material) -> Material:
+    db.commit()
+    db.refresh(material)
+    return material
+
+
+def soft_delete(db: Session, material: Material) -> Material:
+    material.deleted_at = datetime.utcnow()
+    db.commit()
+    db.refresh(material)
+    return material

+import uuid
+from datetime import datetime
+from typing import Any
+
+from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
+
+from src.backend.models.rfq import RFQ, RFQItem, RFQResponse
+
+
+def create_rfq(db: Session, data: dict[str, Any]) -> RFQ:
+    rfq = RFQ(**data)
+    db.add(rfq)
+    db.commit()
+    db.refresh(rfq)
+    return rfq
+
+
+def get_rfq_by_id(db: Session, rfq_id: uuid.UUID) -> RFQ | None:
+    return db.query(RFQ).filter(RFQ.id == rfq_id, RFQ.deleted_at.is_(None)).first()
+
+
+def list_rfqs_for_project(
+    db: Session,
+    project_id: uuid.UUID,
+    page: int = 1,
+    page_size: int = 20,
+) -> tuple[list[RFQ], int, int, int]:
+    query = db.query(RFQ).filter(RFQ.project_id == project_id, RFQ.deleted_at.is_(None))
+    total = query.count()
+    offset = (page - 1) * page_size
+    items = query.order_by(RFQ.created_at.desc()).offset(offset).limit(page_size).all()
+    return items, total, page, page_size
+
+
+def update_rfq(db: Session, rfq_id: uuid.UUID, data: dict[str, Any]) -> RFQ | None:
+    rfq = get_rfq_by_id(db, rfq_id)
+    if not rfq:
+        return None
+    for key, value in data.items():
+        if value is not None:
+            setattr(rfq, key, value)
+    db.commit()
+    db.refresh(rfq)
+    return rfq
+
+
+def soft_delete_rfq(db: Session, rfq_id: uuid.UUID) -> bool:
+    rfq = get_rfq_by_id(db, rfq_id)
+    if not rfq:
+        return False
+    rfq.deleted_at = datetime.utcnow()
+    db.commit()
+    return True
+
+
+def add_rfq_item(db: Session, rfq_id: uuid.UUID, data: dict[str, Any]) -> RFQItem:
+    item = RFQItem(rfq_id=rfq_id, **data)
+    db.add(item)
+    db.commit()
+    db.refresh(item)
+    return item
+
+
+def get_rfq_item(db: Session, item_id: uuid.UUID) -> RFQItem | None:
+    return db.query(RFQItem).filter(RFQItem.id == item_id).first()
+
+
+def list_rfq_items(db: Session, rfq_id: uuid.UUID) -> list[RFQItem]:
+    return db.query(RFQItem).filter(RFQItem.rfq_id == rfq_id).all()
+
+
+def remove_rfq_item(db: Session, item_id: uuid.UUID) -> bool:
+    item = get_rfq_item(db, item_id)
+    if not item:
+        return False
+    db.delete(item)
+    db.commit()
+    return True
+
+
+def create_rfq_response(db: Session, rfq_id: uuid.UUID, data: dict[str, Any]) -> RFQResponse:
+    response = RFQResponse(rfq_id=rfq_id, **data)
+    db.add(response)
+    db.commit()
+    db.refresh(response)
+    return response
+
+
+def get_rfq_response(db: Session, response_id: uuid.UUID) -> RFQResponse | None:
+    return db.query(RFQResponse).filter(RFQResponse.id == response_id).first()
+
+
+def list_rfq_responses(db: Session, rfq_id: uuid.UUID) -> list[RFQResponse]:
+    return db.query(RFQResponse).filter(RFQResponse.rfq_id == rfq_id).all()
+
+
+def update_rfq_response(
+    db: Session, response_id: uuid.UUID, data: dict[str, Any]
+) -> RFQResponse | None:
+    response = get_rfq_response(db, response_id)
+    if not response:
+        return None
+    for key, value in data.items():
+        if value is not None:
+            setattr(response, key, value)
+    db.commit()
+    db.refresh(response)
+    return response
+
+
+def reject_other_responses(db: Session, rfq_id: uuid.UUID, selected_response_id: uuid.UUID) -> None:
+    db.query(RFQResponse).filter(
+        RFQResponse.rfq_id == rfq_id,
+        RFQResponse.id != selected_response_id,
+        RFQResponse.status == "selected",
+    ).update({"status": "rejected"}, synchronize_session=False)
+    db.commit()

+import json
+import uuid
+from datetime import UTC, datetime
+
+from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
+
+from src.backend.models.compliance import ChecklistItem, ComplianceChecklist, ComplianceTemplate
+from src.backend.models.compliance import ChecklistStatus as ModelChecklistStatus
+from src.backend.schemas.compliance import (
+    ChecklistItemUpdate,
+    ComplianceTemplateCreate,
+    ComplianceTemplateRead,
+    InstantiateChecklistRequest,
+)
+
+
+def _template_to_read(template: ComplianceTemplate) -> ComplianceTemplateRead:
+    items_data = []
+    if template.items:
+        try:
+            items_data = json.loads(template.items) if isinstance(template.items, str) else template.items
+        except Exception:
+            items_data = []
+    return ComplianceTemplateRead(
+        id=template.id,
+        name=template.name,
+        standard_code=template.standard_code,
+        category=template.category,
+        is_active=template.is_active,
+        items=items_data,
+        created_at=template.created_at,
+    )
+
+
+def list_templates_service(
+    db: Session,
+    page: int = 1,
+    page_size: int = 20,
+    standard_code: str | None = None,
+    is_active: bool | None = None,
+) -> tuple[list[ComplianceTemplateRead], int, int, int]:
+    query = db.query(ComplianceTemplate)
+    if standard_code:
+        query = query.filter(ComplianceTemplate.standard_code == standard_code)
+    if is_active is not None:
+        query = query.filter(ComplianceTemplate.is_active == is_active)
+
+    total = query.count()
+    templates = (
+        query.order_by(ComplianceTemplate.created_at.desc())
+        .offset((page - 1) * page_size)
+        .limit(page_size)
+        .all()
+    )
+
+    items = [_template_to_read(t) for t in templates]
+    return items, total, page, page_size
+
+
+def create_template_service(
+    db: Session,
+    data: ComplianceTemplateCreate,
+    actor_id: uuid.UUID,
+) -> ComplianceTemplateRead:
+    template = ComplianceTemplate(

+        return None
+    return _template_to_read(template)
+
+
+def _recalculate_checklist_status(checklist: ComplianceChecklist) -> None:
+    items = checklist.items
+    if not items:
+        checklist.status = ModelChecklistStatus.NOT_STARTED.value
+        checklist.completed_at = None
+        return
+
+    total = len(items)
+    completed = sum(1 for item in items if item.is_completed)
+    mandatory_items = [item for item in items if item.is_mandatory]
+    mandatory_incomplete = sum(1 for item in mandatory_items if not item.is_completed)
+
+    if mandatory_incomplete > 0:
+        checklist.status = ModelChecklistStatus.IN_PROGRESS.value
+        checklist.completed_at = None
+    elif completed == total:
+        checklist.status = ModelChecklistStatus.COMPLETED.value
+        checklist.completed_at = datetime.now(UTC)
+    elif completed == 0:
+        checklist.status = ModelChecklistStatus.NOT_STARTED.value
+        checklist.completed_at = None
+    else:
+        checklist.status = ModelChecklistStatus.IN_PROGRESS.value
+        checklist.completed_at = None
+
+
+def _checklist_to_read(checklist: ComplianceChecklist) -> dict:
+    items = checklist.items
+    total = len(items) if items else 0
+    completed = sum(1 for item in items if item.is_completed) if items else 0
+    progress = (completed / total * 100) if total > 0 else 0.0
+
+    return {
+        "id": checklist.id,
+        "project_id": checklist.project_id,
+        "template_id": checklist.template_id,
+        "status": checklist.status,
+        "completed_at": checklist.completed_at,
+        "created_at": checklist.created_at,
+        "template_name": checklist.template.name if checklist.template else None,
+        "template_standard_code": checklist.template.standard_code if checklist.template else None,
+        "progress_percent": round(progress, 2),
+        "items": [
+            {
+                "id": item.id,
+                "checklist_id": item.checklist_id,
+                "description": item.description,
+                "category": item.category,
+                "is_mandatory": item.is_mandatory,
+                "is_completed": item.is_completed,
+                "completed_by": item.completed_by,
+                "completed_at": item.completed_at,
+                "evidence_document_id": item.evidence_document_id,
+            }
+            for item in items
+        ],
+    }

+
+def list_project_checklists_service(

+) -> tuple[list[dict], int, int, int]:

+    total = query.count()
+    checklists = (
+        query.order_by(ComplianceChecklist.created_at.desc())
+        .offset((page - 1) * page_size)
+        .limit(page_size)
+        .all()
+    )
+
+    items = [_checklist_to_read(c) for c in checklists]
+    return items, total, page, page_size

+
+def instantiate_checklist_service(
+    db: Session,

+) -> dict | None:
+    template = db.query(ComplianceTemplate).filter(ComplianceTemplate.id == data.template_id).first()
+    if not template:

+
+    items_data = []
+    if template.items:
+        try:
+            items_data = json.loads(template.items) if isinstance(template.items, str) else template.items
+        except Exception:
+            items_data = []
+
+    checklist = ComplianceChecklist(
+        project_id=project_id,
+        template_id=template.id,
+        status=ModelChecklistStatus.NOT_STARTED.value,
+    )
+    db.add(checklist)
+    db.flush()
+
+    for item_data in items_data:
+        item = ChecklistItem(
+            checklist_id=checklist.id,
+            description=item_data.get("description", ""),
+            category=item_data.get("category"),
+            is_mandatory=item_data.get("is_mandatory", False),
+            is_completed=False,
+        )
+        db.add(item)
+
+    db.commit()
+    db.refresh(checklist)
+
+    checklist_items = db.query(ChecklistItem).filter(ChecklistItem.checklist_id == checklist.id).all()
+    checklist.items = checklist_items
+
+    return _checklist_to_read(checklist)

+
+def get_checklist_service(db: Session, checklist_id: uuid.UUID) -> dict | None:
+    checklist = db.query(ComplianceChecklist).filter(ComplianceChecklist.id == checklist_id).first()
+    if not checklist:

+    return _checklist_to_read(checklist)

+
+def update_checklist_item_service(
+    db: Session,
+    checklist_id: uuid.UUID,
+    item_id: uuid.UUID,
+    data: ChecklistItemUpdate,
+    actor_id: uuid.UUID,
+) -> dict | None:
+    item = (
+        db.query(ChecklistItem)
+        .filter(ChecklistItem.id == item_id, ChecklistItem.checklist_id == checklist_id)
+        .first()
+    )
+    if not item:
+        return None
+
+    item.is_completed = data.is_completed
+    if data.evidence_document_id is not None:
+        item.evidence_document_id = data.evidence_document_id
+    if data.is_completed:
+        item.completed_by = actor_id
+        item.completed_at = datetime.now(UTC)
+    else:
+        item.completed_by = None
+        item.completed_at = None

+    db.commit()
+    db.refresh(item)

+    checklist = db.query(ComplianceChecklist).filter(ComplianceChecklist.id == checklist_id).first()

+        return _checklist_to_read(checklist)

+import uuid
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
+
+from src.backend.models.document import Document
+
+UPLOAD_DIR = Path("uploads/projects")
+MAX_FILE_SIZE = 50 * 1024 * 1024
+ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS = {".pdf", ".dwg", ".docx", ".xlsx", ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".png", ".zip"}
+
+CONTENT_TYPE_MAP = {
+    ".pdf": "application/pdf",
+    ".dwg": "application/acad",
+    ".docx": "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document",
+    ".xlsx": "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet",
+    ".jpg": "image/jpeg",
+    ".jpeg": "image/jpeg",
+    ".png": "image/png",
+    ".zip": "application/zip",
+}
+
+
+def _ensure_dir(project_id: uuid.UUID, category: str) -> Path:
+    d = UPLOAD_DIR / str(project_id) / "documents" / category
+    d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    return d
+
+
+def _save_file(project_id: uuid.UUID, category: str, original_name: str, file_bytes: bytes) -> tuple[str, str]:
+    ext = Path(original_name).suffix.lower()
+    safe_name = f"{uuid.uuid4().hex}_{original_name}"
+    d = _ensure_dir(project_id, category)
+    path = d / safe_name
+    path.write_bytes(file_bytes)
+    mime = CONTENT_TYPE_MAP.get(ext, "application/octet-stream")
+    return str(path), mime
+
+
+def _get_latest_version(db: Session, project_id: uuid.UUID, original_name: str) -> Document | None:
+    return (
+        db.query(Document)
+        .filter(
+            Document.project_id == project_id,
+            Document.original_name == original_name,
+            not Document.is_deleted,
+        )
+        .order_by(Document.version.desc())
+        .first()
+    )
+
+
+def upload_document(
+    db: Session,
+    project_id: uuid.UUID,
+    file_bytes: bytes,
+    original_name: str,
+    category: str,
+    uploaded_by: uuid.UUID | None,
+) -> Document:
+    if len(file_bytes) > MAX_FILE_SIZE:
+        raise ValueError("File exceeds 50MB limit")
+
+    ext = Path(original_name).suffix.lower()
+    if ext not in ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS:
+        raise ValueError(f"Invalid file type. Allowed: {', '.join(sorted(ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS))}")
+
+    latest = _get_latest_version(db, project_id, original_name)
+    version = (latest.version + 1) if latest else 1
+    previous_version_id = latest.id if latest else None
+
+    file_path, mime_type = _save_file(project_id, category, original_name, file_bytes)
+
+    doc = Document(
+        project_id=project_id,
+        name=original_name,
+        original_name=original_name,
+        file_path=file_path,
+        category=category,
+        version=version,
+        previous_version_id=previous_version_id,
+        size_bytes=len(file_bytes),
+        mime_type=mime_type,
+        uploaded_by=uploaded_by,
+    )
+    db.add(doc)
+    db.commit()
+    db.refresh(doc)
+    return doc
+
+
+def list_documents(
+    db: Session,
+    project_id: uuid.UUID,
+    category: str | None = None,
+    page: int = 1,
+    page_size: int = 20,
+) -> tuple[list[Document], int]:
+    query = db.query(Document).filter(Document.project_id == project_id, not Document.is_deleted)
+    if category:
+        query = query.filter(Document.category == category)
+    total = query.count()
+    offset = (page - 1) * page_size
+    items = query.order_by(Document.uploaded_at.desc()).offset(offset).limit(page_size).all()
+    return items, total
+
+
+def get_document(db: Session, document_id: uuid.UUID) -> Document | None:
+    return db.query(Document).filter(Document.id == document_id, not Document.is_deleted).first()
+
+
+def soft_delete_document(db: Session, document_id: uuid.UUID) -> bool:
+    doc = get_document(db, document_id)
+    if not doc:
+        return False
+    doc.is_deleted = True
+    db.commit()
+    return True
+
+
+def get_document_versions(db: Session, document_id: uuid.UUID) -> list[Document]:
+    doc = get_document(db, document_id)
+    if not doc:
+        return []
+
+    all_versions: list[Document] = []
+    current: Document | None = doc
+    while current:
+        all_versions.append(current)
+        if current.previous_version_id:
+            current = db.query(Document).filter(Document.id == current.previous_version_id).first()
+        else:
+            current = None
+
+    return all_versions

+import uuid
+from collections import deque
+
+from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
+
+from src.backend.db.repositories.audit_repo import create_entry
+from src.backend.models.enums import (
+    TaskPriority,
+    TaskStatus,
+    can_transition_status,
+)
+from src.backend.models.task import Task, TaskDependency
+from src.backend.schemas.task import TaskCreate, TaskUpdate
+
+
+def _task_to_dict(task: Task, include_subtasks: bool = False, include_deps: bool = False) -> dict:
+    assignee_name = task.assignee.name if task.assignee else None
+    creator_name = task.creator.name if task.creator else None
+
+    subtasks = []
+    if include_subtasks:
+        for st in task.subtasks:
+            if not st.is_deleted:
+                subtasks.append(_task_to_dict(st, include_subtasks=True))
+
+    deps = []
+    if include_deps:
+        for d in task.dependencies:
+            deps.append({
+                "id": str(d.id),
+                "task_id": str(d.task_id),
+                "depends_on_task_id": str(d.depends_on_task_id),
+                "created_at": d.created_at,
+            })
+
+    return {
+        "id": task.id,
+        "project_id": task.project_id,
+        "parent_id": task.parent_id,
+        "title": task.title,
+        "description": task.description,
+        "status": task.status,
+        "priority": task.priority,
+        "assignee_id": task.assignee_id,
+        "assignee_name": assignee_name,
+        "created_by": task.created_by,
+        "creator_name": creator_name,
+        "due_date": task.due_date,
+        "estimated_hours": task.estimated_hours,
+        "actual_hours": task.actual_hours,
+        "boq_item_id": task.boq_item_id,
+        "is_deleted": task.is_deleted,
+        "created_at": task.created_at,
+        "updated_at": task.updated_at,
+        "subtasks": subtasks,
+        "dependencies": deps,
+    }
+
+
+def _check_cyclic_dependency(db: Session, task_id: uuid.UUID, depends_on_id: uuid.UUID) -> bool:
+    visited = set()
+    queue = deque([depends_on_id])
+    while queue:
+        current = queue.popleft()
+        if current == task_id:
+            return True
+        if current in visited:
+            continue
+        visited.add(current)
+        deps = db.query(TaskDependency).filter(TaskDependency.task_id == current).all()
+        for dep in deps:
+            queue.append(dep.depends_on_task_id)
+    return False
+
+
+def _get_incomplete_dependencies(db: Session, task_id: uuid.UUID) -> list[Task]:
+    deps = db.query(TaskDependency).filter(TaskDependency.task_id == task_id).all()
+    incomplete = []
+    for dep in deps:
+        blocker = db.query(Task).filter(Task.id == dep.depends_on_task_id, Task.is_deleted == False).first()
+        if blocker and blocker.status != TaskStatus.DONE.value:
+            incomplete.append(blocker)
+    return incomplete
+
+
+def create_task_service(db: Session, project_id: uuid.UUID, data: TaskCreate, actor_id: uuid.UUID) -> dict:
+    task = Task(
+        project_id=project_id,
+        title=data.title,
+        description=data.description,
+        priority=data.priority or TaskPriority.MEDIUM.value,
+        assignee_id=data.assignee_id,
+        created_by=actor_id,
+        due_date=data.due_date,
+        estimated_hours=data.estimated_hours,
+        parent_id=data.parent_id,
+        boq_item_id=data.boq_item_id,
+        status=TaskStatus.TODO.value,
+    )
+    db.add(task)
+    db.flush()
+
+    create_entry(
+        db,
+        action="task.create",
+        entity_type="task",
+        entity_id=task.id,
+        user_id=actor_id,
+        after_json={"title": task.title, "status": task.status},
+    )
+    db.commit()
+    db.refresh(task)
+    return _task_to_dict(task)
+
+
+def get_task_service(db: Session, task_id: uuid.UUID) -> dict | None:
+    task = db.query(Task).filter(Task.id == task_id, Task.is_deleted == False).first()
+    if not task:
+        return None
+    return _task_to_dict(task, include_subtasks=True, include_deps=True)
+
+
+def list_tasks_service(
+    db: Session,
+    project_id: uuid.UUID,
+    page: int = 1,
+    page_size: int = 20,
+    tree: bool = False,
+    assignee_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
+) -> tuple[list[dict], int]:
+    query = db.query(Task).filter(Task.project_id == project_id, Task.is_deleted == False)
+    if assignee_id:
+        query = query.filter(Task.assignee_id == assignee_id)
+    total = query.count()
+    offset = (page - 1) * page_size
+    tasks = query.order_by(Task.created_at.desc()).offset(offset).limit(page_size).all()
+
+    if tree:
+        task_dicts = [_task_to_dict(t, include_subtasks=True) for t in tasks]
+        return task_dicts, total
+
+    result = []
+    for t in tasks:
+        result.append(_task_to_dict(t))
+    return result, total
+
+
+def update_task_service(db: Session, task_id: uuid.UUID, data: TaskUpdate, actor_id: uuid.UUID) -> dict | None:
+    task = db.query(Task).filter(Task.id == task_id, Task.is_deleted == False).first()
+    if not task:
+        return None
+
+    before = _task_to_dict(task)
+
+    if data.title is not None:
+        task.title = data.title
+    if data.description is not None:
+        task.description = data.description
+    if data.priority is not None:
+        task.priority = data.priority
+    if data.assignee_id is not None:
+        task.assignee_id = data.assignee_id
+    if data.due_date is not None:
+        task.due_date = data.due_date
+    if data.estimated_hours is not None:
+        task.estimated_hours = data.estimated_hours
+    if data.is_deleted is not None:
+        task.is_deleted = data.is_deleted
+
+    db.commit()
+    db.refresh(task)
+
+    after = _task_to_dict(task)
+    create_entry(
+        db,
+        action="task.update",
+        entity_type="task",
+        entity_id=task.id,
+        user_id=actor_id,
+        before_json=before,
+        after_json=after,
+    )
+    return after
+
+
+def delete_task_service(db: Session, task_id: uuid.UUID, actor_id: uuid.UUID) -> bool:
+    task = db.query(Task).filter(Task.id == task_id, Task.is_deleted == False).first()
+    if not task:
+        return False
+
+    def soft_delete_children(parent_id: uuid.UUID):
+        children = db.query(Task).filter(Task.parent_id == parent_id, Task.is_deleted == False).all()
+        for child in children:
+            child.is_deleted = True
+            soft_delete_children(child.id)
+
+    task.is_deleted = True
+    soft_delete_children(task_id)
+    db.commit()
+
+    create_entry(
+        db,
+        action="task.delete",
+        entity_type="task",
+        entity_id=task.id,
+        user_id=actor_id,
+        before_json={"title": task.title},
+    )
+    return True
+
+
+def transition_task_status_service(
+    db: Session,
+    task_id: uuid.UUID,
+    new_status: str,
+    actor_id: uuid.UUID,
+) -> dict:
+    task = db.query(Task).filter(Task.id == task_id, Task.is_deleted == False).first()
+    if not task:
+        raise ValueError("Task not found")
+
+    try:
+        from_status = TaskStatus(task.status)
+        to_status = TaskStatus(new_status)
+    except ValueError:
+        raise ValueError(f"Invalid status: {new_status}")
+
+    if not can_transition_status(from_status, to_status):
+        raise ValueError(f"Cannot transition from {from_status.value} to {to_status.value}")
+
+    if to_status == TaskStatus.IN_PROGRESS:
+        incomplete = _get_incomplete_dependencies(db, task_id)
+        if incomplete:
+            names = [t.title for t in incomplete]
+            raise ValueError(f"Dependencies not done: {', '.join(names)}")
+
+    before_status = task.status
+    task.status = to_status.value
+    db.commit()
+    db.refresh(task)
+
+    create_entry(
+        db,
+        action="task.status_change",
+        entity_type="task",
+        entity_id=task.id,
+        user_id=actor_id,
+        before_json={"status": before_status},
+        after_json={"status": to_status.value},
+    )
+    return _task_to_dict(task)
+
+
+def add_dependency_service(
+    db: Session,
+    task_id: uuid.UUID,
+    depends_on_task_id: uuid.UUID,
+    actor_id: uuid.UUID,
+) -> dict:
+    if task_id == depends_on_task_id:
+        raise ValueError("Task cannot depend on itself")
+
+    existing = db.query(TaskDependency).filter(
+        TaskDependency.task_id == task_id,
+        TaskDependency.depends_on_task_id == depends_on_task_id,
+    ).first()
+    if existing:
+        raise ValueError("Dependency already exists")
+
+    if _check_cyclic_dependency(db, task_id, depends_on_task_id):
+        raise ValueError("Adding this dependency would create a cycle")
+
+    task = db.query(Task).filter(Task.id == task_id, Task.is_deleted == False).first()
+    if not task:
+        raise ValueError("Task not found")
+
+    blocker = db.query(Task).filter(Task.id == depends_on_task_id, Task.is_deleted == False).first()
+    if not blocker:
+        raise ValueError("Blocking task not found")
+
+    dep = TaskDependency(task_id=task_id, depends_on_task_id=depends_on_task_id)
+    db.add(dep)
+    db.commit()
+    db.refresh(dep)
+
+    create_entry(
+        db,
+        action="task.dependency_add",
+        entity_type="task",
+        entity_id=task_id,
+        user_id=actor_id,
+        after_json={"depends_on": str(depends_on_task_id)},
+    )
+    return _task_to_dict(task, include_deps=True)
+
+
+def remove_dependency_service(
+    db: Session,
+    task_id: uuid.UUID,
+    dependency_id: uuid.UUID,
+    actor_id: uuid.UUID,
+) -> bool:
+    dep = db.query(TaskDependency).filter(
+        TaskDependency.id == dependency_id,
+        TaskDependency.task_id == task_id,
+    ).first()
+    if not dep:
+        return False
+
+    db.delete(dep)
+    db.commit()
+
+    create_entry(
+        db,
+        action="task.dependency_remove",
+        entity_type="task",
+        entity_id=task_id,
+        user_id=actor_id,
+        before_json={"dependency_id": str(dependency_id)},
+    )
+    return True
+
+
+def list_my_tasks_service(
+    db: Session,
+    user_id: uuid.UUID,
+    page: int = 1,
+    page_size: int = 20,
+) -> tuple[list[dict], int]:
+    query = db.query(Task).filter(Task.assignee_id == user_id, Task.is_deleted == False)
+    total = query.count()
+    offset = (page - 1) * page_size
+    tasks = query.order_by(Task.due_date.asc().nulls_last(), Task.priority.desc()).offset(offset).limit(page_size).all()
+    return [_task_to_dict(t) for t in tasks], total
